messages:
maya_marketing: Quick sync for v1.8 public announce — need final changelog line, docs URL, benchmark topline, hero asset, embargo time, webinar slot, and lead routing by Mon EOD.

derek_pm: @sam_eng @anya_docs tagging for changelog + docs. @lena_growth for benchmarks/webinar.

sam_eng: Changelog sentence coming today: 'v1.8 reduces tail latency and lowers token cost with an opt-in `cache_hint` flag.' Canary: canary-507, start 2026-03-31 14:00 PT, stagger 10->25->50, fallback to v1.7.

anya_docs: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/938. Will add migration snippet and "what's improved" bullets. Final URL posted when merged.

lena_growth: Benchmark topline: "Up to 18% lower p95 and up to 22% lower token-cost in steady-state tests on p4d." Drive with graphs by EOD. Webinar proposed Thu 2026-04-09 10:00 PT. Registration will route leads to growth-sdrs@redwood.ai (and enterprisect@redwood.ai if 'Dedicated eval' selected).

maya_marketing: Marketing checklist (confirm by Mon EOD): 1) single-line changelog 2) merged docs URL 3) 3-bullet benchmark summary + graphs 4) hero png/gif 5) canary id + start time 6) embargo lift time 7) PRs to credit.

sam_eng: Confirmed — I'll drop changelog, canary id, screenshot, and PR links.

deploy-bot: Deploy window confirmed: 2026-03-31 14:00 PT. Reminder 30m prior.

maya_marketing: Thanks — will assemble draft and post for review once assets are in.
